name: IP-LAD
summary: IP-LAD, or IPLAD, also known as IPR-LAD or as 6-isopropyl-6-nor-LSD, is an analogue of lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD) developed by the team of David E. Nichols. In studies on mice, it was found to be approximately 40% the potency of LSD, compared to the 60% increase in potency seen with ETH-LAD, 2-fold potency increase of AL-LAD, and roughly equivalent potency of PRO-LAD.

pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen
